items.title: Weaponized ScreenConnect RMM Tool Tricks Users into Downloading Xworm RAT
items.description: In a sophisticated campaign uncovered during a recent Advanced Continual Threat Hunt (ACTH) by Trustwave’s SpiderLabs team, threat actors weaponized a legitimate remote management tool, ScreenConnect, to deploy the Xworm Remote Access Trojan (RAT) through a deceptive, multi-stage infection chain.
